numerics.note: Ex22 modelling decision (tail-protocol rung 3, disclosed): the descent from Mc to the residual c*My is spread over 0.5a of hinge rotation instead of the default 0.15a (near-vertical). Reason: with 660 IMK hinges the near-vertical drop stopped the static solver at Vmax in both directions and produced non-convergence in the first Chapter 16 record (Imperial Valley Delta, 21 failed steps at 2% drift). The change eases the numerics; it does not alter a, b, c or the acceptance limits.
